package macros // import "example.com/gp/macros"

Package macros has the syntax that only gocpp has: the error shape func f!() T,
macros, and #Derive.

VARIABLES

var ErrSyntax = errors.New("syntax")
    ErrSyntax is the error of Parse.


FUNCTIONS

macro Assert(cond bool, msg lazy string)
    Assert stops the program when cond is false.

macro Locked(mu *int)
    Locked runs the body of a function under a lock.

func Parse!(s string) int
    Parse reads a number. It fails with ErrSyntax when s is not one.

#Trace()
func Run()
    Run does the work and traces it.

macro Trace() func()
    Trace logs the start of a function and its end.


TYPES

#Derive(String)
type Color int
    Color is a color.

    #Derive(String) makes the names of the values.

const (
	Red Color = iota
	Green
	Blue
)
    The colors.

func (c Color) String() string
    String is generated by #Derive(String).

#Derive(JSON)
type Config struct {
	Port int
}
    Config is read from JSON.

func (c *Config) Load!(path string)
    Load reads a config and fails with an error.

func (c Config) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error)
    MarshalJSON is generated by #Derive(JSON).

func (c *Config) UnmarshalJSON(data []byte) error
    UnmarshalJSON is generated by #Derive(JSON).

#Derive(String, Equal, Clone)
type Point struct {
	X, Y int
}
    Point is a point of the plane.

func (p Point) Clone() Point
    Clone is generated by #Derive(Clone).

func (p Point) Equal(other Point) bool
    Equal is generated by #Derive(Equal).

func (p Point) Norm() int
    Norm is the length of p.

func (p Point) String() string
    String is generated by #Derive(String).
